run_sol_distri: run the sol_distri script with a root directory to plot solution order distribution histograms
run_load_all: run load_all from analyze_util to load experiment configurations from a parameter sweep root directory
run_load_model_traj: run load_model_traj from analyze_util to load model trajectory data from a folder at specific indices
run_freq_pattern_analysis: run frequency pattern analysis on model weights to compute solution order distributions across hyperparameters
run_solution_distribution_plot: run the solution distribution plot generation that creates a 3x5 histogram grid saved as a PDF
